desc:
🛎️ The owner's out of town for a week. You and your crew are running his roadside motel.

  Check guests in, hand out room keys, clean rooms, deliver towels and pizza, plunge toilets and fix whatever breaks.
  Make enough money before he's back. 💵

  But not every guest is who they say they are... 🪪

  🔍 Check every ID. The photo might not match the face.
  🔑 Lock-pickers sneak into empty rooms.
  ⛈️ Storms knock the power out.
  🪟 Someone's at the window.
  👁️ Night 7... he's been watching all week.

  Survive all 7 nights, then keep going in Endless.

  🤝 1-5 players. Better with friends!
  🎧 Headphones recommended.
  👍 Like + ⭐ Favorite for updates!
